title: KYSE150_SREBF1 ChIP-Seq
processing: ChIP-Seq pair-end 150bp reads were aligned to the hg19 reference genome using Bowtie2. RNA-seq reads were trimmed for adaptor sequence, and then mapped to hg19 whole genome using STAR. | Adaptors were removed using Trim galore software. Each replicate, the raw reads were aligned to masked version of the reference human genome hg19. | PCR duplicate reads were removed using Picard MarkDuplicates in Chip-seq | Blacklist regions were removed using ENCODE blacklist file in Chip-seq | Peaks were called subsequently using macs2 while simultaneously generating bedgraph files in Reads Per Million scale. | Genome_build: hg19 | Supplementary_files_format_and_content: bigwig files representing signal normalized to per million reads
